comment: Every torch call in the FORBIDDEN list that survives anywhere under witwin/, classified. Scope is the WHOLE tree with an empty exclusion list, because the previous scan covered one package and a narrow scope is a silent way to grow an allowlist. Keyed by (module, function, call, occurrences); equality in both directions. A recorded entry states what an expression IS - several are debt, not approval. Enforced by ci/check_torch_physics_allowlist.py, whose FROZEN_BASELINE_DIGEST covers this whole document.

categories.freeze_time_pose: Pose, axis and layout normalisation. Runs once per radar, per set_pose or per authored motion, never per path. R-ADR-007 lists Core scene authoring and typed-contract construction in the Torch allowlist.
categories.freeze_time_validation: A constructor-time precondition. It produces no simulated quantity; it decides whether an authored value is legal.
categories.dsp_window: A window function over a sample or bin axis, downstream of the radar cube. R-ADR-017's frozen DSP surface and R-ADR-007's DSP exception.
categories.dsp_replica: A reference waveform or steering vector built for correlation or estimation, downstream of the cube. It reconstructs a KNOWN transmit or array law to match against measured samples; it does not evaluate scene propagation.
categories.dsp_estimation: Angle, Doppler or phase estimation over the cube. Behind the R-ADR-018 non-differentiability wall.
categories.result_assembly: Per-response, not per-path, construction of a complex result whose per-path factors are all native.
categories.legacy_pose_authoring: Body-model pose math on the legacy SMPL route, upstream of the Core/Channel compile boundary.
categories.work_item_8_survivor: Recorded DEBT. Phase-6 work item 8 names this expression and it has not moved into a kernel yet. Frozen so it cannot grow, and it may not be joined by a sibling.
categories.freeze_time_pattern_oracle: Recorded DEBT found by this gate's widened scope. The production per-path antenna weight is the native sensor_weight family; this Torch route is the freeze-time and oracle evaluator.

entries.reason: Rodrigues rotation for the SMPL joint axis-angle vectors, 24 joints per frame. It authors a deformed rest mesh that then crosses the Core compile boundary; it is not per-path propagation. The legacy SMPL route is already a recorded exception in tests/test_phase6_no_torch_physics.py::PHASE9_KNOWN_REQUIRES_GRAD_ROUTES.
The cosine half of the same Rodrigues expression.
Removes the known TDM slot phase ramp from an already-measured cube so the virtual array is coherent. The ramp is a property of the transmit schedule, not of the scene.
Phase-comparison angle estimation across two measured channels.
The uniform planar array steering law used as the estimator's search dictionary. It is a function of the array geometry and the scan grid only; it evaluates no path.
The complex assembly of the same steering dictionary, azimuth and elevation axes.
The conventional beamformer's steering vector over the same array-geometry dictionary.
The short-time transform's analysis window, over the frame index.

Hann, Hamming and Blackman coefficients over the sample index. Five occurrences because Blackman needs two harmonics and each family names the axis once; the count is frozen so a sixth cannot appear unnoticed.
The matched filter's reference LFM chirp, built from the CONFIGURED sweep rather than from any path.
The quadrature half of the same reference chirp.
Row normalisation of an authored direction array. Already frozen by equality in tests/test_phase6_no_torch_physics.py::RADAR_FACADE_TORCH_PHYSICS.
Orthonormalising the forward/right/up basis once per set_pose.
The same orthonormalisation when the world-from-local matrix is rebuilt.

The Torch chirp exp(j 2 pi (fc t + S t^2 / 2)). tests/reference/dsp_oracles.py still needs Radar.waveform to build the independent time-domain reference, so deleting it would delete the oracle's input. Recorded gap in the Phase-6 completion record.
Belongs to the legacy NoiseModelRuntime that FrontendChain replaced. Deleting the legacy noise and receiver runtimes is a separate change with its own evidence.

ScalarRcsResponse's per-target complex assembly: one complex number per target, broadcast across its rows. R-ADR-007 places it inside the Torch allowlist by name, and its aspect-dependent successor is native (scatter_response_aspect). Already frozen by equality in tests/test_phase6_no_torch_physics.py::PHASE9_RCS_TORCH_CALLS.

FOUND BY THIS GATE'S WIDENED SCOPE - sensors/ was nominally an owner package but the forbidden-call scan only ever walked solvers/. Direction vectors to azimuth and elevation degrees before a pattern-table interpolation. The production per-path antenna weight is the native sensor_weight family (kernels/sensor_weight.cu, 3 operators); this Torch route is what AntennaPattern.evaluate_xy's own docstring calls freeze-time work and the kernel's oracle. Its only callers are the public Radar.evaluate_antenna_pattern_vectors accessor and tests/reference/path_math.py. Recorded as debt rather than repaired: moving it is a numerical change and Phase 10 is an architecture phase.
The shared row-normalisation utility used by scene and pose authoring.
